items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Smokey? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Smokey, I don't have that ability.

ctx.x: Smokey, I don't have that ability. You know? I don't hear that register like that, I don't hear it above the natural range of my instrument. I mean I just popped a high C or D just for the hell of popping it, it's not part of the line I hear. And Dizzy clarified it for me, he said, “That's your spot." When Bird speaks, I listen. (Laughs) Now, who is this?
